warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0109; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘No, it isn't here yet.’ and ‘He isn't here yet either.’ are natural short spoken uses of temporal yet.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps yet to «هنوز/تا این لحظه» without changing the target sense.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical sense is introduced, recognized, practiced in dialogue, transferred, then retrieved from a hidden prompt.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast time meanings and unrelated target candidates without random noise.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Waiting at a bus stop gives a concrete reason to ask whether the bus and driver have arrived yet.

difficultyFit.evidence: Responses are short and controlled for A1; either adds only a small transfer burden.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: yet recurs across meaning recognition, listening, choice, dialogue and hidden spoken retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The second use shifts from the bus to the driver while preserving the same temporal meaning.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scenario, target construction, turns and final retrieval all align to one bounded sense.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; subjective engagement remains unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the temporal A1 sense of yet is reviewed.
Generated audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
